title: Who reads the papers? - Yes, Prime Minister - BBC comedy
summary: A short clip from the BBC sitcom Yes, Prime Minister in which Jim Hacker explains which kind of person reads which British newspaper. It is a satirical take on press readership and bias.
why: Posted as a joke and a reference whenever threads discuss newspaper bias and media pandering to readers.
